heading.en: Early life and the Red Army years

body.zh-Hant: 彭德懷（1898–1974）生於湖南湘潭，畢業於湖南軍官學校，曾在國民革命軍任連長。1928年6月在湖南平江起義，同年12月於井岡山與朱德、毛澤東會合；1930年7月佔領長沙。其後在蔣介石的五次圍剿中任第三軍團長，長征途中任北上部隊總指揮，1935年以三軍團長身分出席遵義會議。
body.en: Peng Dehuai (1898–1974) came from Xiangtan in Hunan and graduated from the Hunan military academy; he served as a regimental commander in the National Revolutionary Army. He rose in revolt at Pingjiang in June 1928, joined Zhu De and Mao Zedong at Jinggangshan in December of that year, and took Changsha in July 1930. In Chiang Kai-shek's five encirclement campaigns he commanded the Third Army Corps, led the northbound force on the Long March, and attended the 1935 Zunyi Conference as corps commander.

heading.en: The War of Resistance and the Hundred Regiments Offensive

body.zh-Hant: 1937年國共再度合作後，彭德懷任八路軍副總司令，駐山西東南部司令部，在朱德留延安期間實際主持軍務，並指揮1940年的百團大戰這場戰役。1945年他當選中共中央委員。
body.en: After the second Kuomintang–Communist cooperation in 1937, Peng became deputy commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army, based in southeastern Shanxi, and in practice acted as commander-in-chief while Zhu De was in Yan'an; he also directed the Hundred Regiments Offensive of 1940, a major campaign. In 1945 he was elected to the Party Central Committee.

heading.en: Civil war, Korea and downfall

body.zh-Hant: 國共內戰中彭德懷歷任西北解放軍司令、第一野戰軍司令，1950年起指揮中國人民志願軍參加朝鮮戰爭。1954年任副總理兼國防部長，1955年成為解放軍十大元帥之一。1959年廬山會議上因批評大躍進而被解除國防部長職務，1974年去世。
body.en: In the civil war Peng commanded the Northwest People's Liberation Army and then the First Field Army, and from 1950 he led the Chinese People's Volunteers in the Korean War. He became vice-premier and defence minister in 1954 and one of the ten marshals of the PLA in 1955. After criticising the Great Leap Forward at the 1959 Lushan meeting he was dismissed as defence minister, and he died in 1974.

heading.en: The Northwest theatre

body.zh-Hant: 1947年3月起，彭德懷任西北野戰兵團（後相繼改稱西北野戰軍、第一野戰軍）司令員兼政治委員，以兩萬餘人的部隊對抗進攻陝甘寧解放區的23萬國民黨軍。他在一個半月內於青化砭、羊馬河、蟠龍鎮三戰三捷，同年8月指揮沙家店戰役，1948年4月21日在西府隴東戰役中收復延安；1949年他指揮第一野戰軍等部，經陝中、扶眉、蘭州、寧夏、河西等戰役解放西北五省。
body.en: From March 1947 Peng commanded the Northwest Field Corps (later the Northwest Field Army and the First Field Army) as commander and political commissar, facing 230,000 Nationalist troops attacking the Shaan-Gan-Ning area with a force of just over 20,000. He won three successive victories at Qinghuabian, Yangmahe and Panlongzhen within six weeks, directed the Shajiadian campaign in August, and retook Yan'an on 21 April 1948 in the Xifu–Longdong campaign. In 1949 he led the First Field Army and other forces through the Shaanzhong, Fufeng, Lanzhou, Ningxia and Hexi campaigns to liberate five northwestern provinces.

heading.en: The Korean War

body.zh-Hant: 1950年10月，彭德懷出任中國人民志願軍司令員兼政治委員，率志願軍跨過鴨綠江，與朝鮮人民軍一道迎戰以美國為首的「聯合國軍」。第二次戰役中他先後退示弱、誘敵深入，再猛烈反擊；第三次戰役突破三八線防禦陣地、占領漢城；第五次戰役後戰線穩定在三八線附近。1953年6月他返回朝鮮前線，建議並組織金城戰役，7月28日以志願軍司令官身分在朝鮮停戰協定上簽字。
body.en: In October 1950 Peng became commander and political commissar of the Chinese People's Volunteers, leading them across the Yalu to fight alongside the Korean People's Army against the US-led "UN forces". In the Second Campaign he first withdrew to show weakness and lure the enemy in, then counter-attacked; in the Third Campaign he broke the 38th-parallel defences and took Seoul; after the Fifth Campaign the front stabilised near the 38th parallel. He returned to the front in June 1953, proposed and organised the Kumsong campaign, and on 28 July signed the Korean Armistice Agreement as commander of the Volunteers.

heading.en: Early career and the Nanchang Uprising

body.zh-Hant: 朱德（1886–1976）生於四川儀隴的貧農家庭，1909年入雲南講武學堂，辛亥革命時任蔡鍔軍的步兵中隊長。1922年赴德國，在柏林結識周恩來並入中國共產黨。1927年任南昌軍官學校校長兼公安局長，同年8月1日與周恩來、賀龍、葉挺、劉伯承等在南昌發動武裝起義。
body.en: Zhu De (1886–1976) was born into a poor peasant family in Yilong, Sichuan, entered the Yunnan Military Academy in 1909, and took part in the 1911 Revolution as an infantry company commander under Cai E. In 1922 he went to Germany, where he met Zhou Enlai and joined the Chinese Communist Party. In 1927 he became head of the Nanchang officers' school and of the public security bureau, and on 1 August that year joined Zhou Enlai, He Long, Ye Ting and Liu Bocheng in the Nanchang armed uprising.

heading.en: Commander-in-chief of the Red Army and the Long March

body.zh-Hant: 1928年4月朱德在井岡山與毛澤東的部隊會合，5月建立紅軍第四軍並任軍長；1930年任紅軍總司令，1931年任中華蘇維埃共和國臨時政府軍事委員會主席。1934年隨黨中央長征，1935年1月遵義會議支持毛澤東掌握黨的主導權，1936年率第四方面軍北上，在陝西與中央會合。
body.en: In April 1928 Zhu De reached Jinggangshan and joined Mao Zedong's force; in May the Fourth Red Army was formed with him as its commander. He became Red Army commander-in-chief in 1930 and chairman of the military committee of the Chinese Soviet Republic's provisional government in 1931. He went on the Long March in 1934, backed Mao at the Zunyi Conference in January 1935, and in 1936 led the Fourth Front Army north to rejoin the centre in Shaanxi.

heading.en: Commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army

body.zh-Hant: 1937年國共合作後，紅軍改編為八路軍，朱德任總司令，在山西前線抗擊日軍，1939年回到延安。1945年他出任中共中央書記處書記，並在其後的內戰期間擔任人民解放軍總司令，指揮遼瀋、淮海、平津三大戰役，擊潰國民黨軍。
body.en: After the Kuomintang–Communist cooperation of 1937 the Red Army was reorganised as the Eighth Route Army with Zhu De as commander-in-chief; he fought the Japanese at the Shanxi front and returned to Yan'an in 1939. In 1945 he became a secretary of the Party Secretariat, and in the ensuing civil war, as commander-in-chief of the People's Liberation Army, he directed the Liaoshen, Huaihai and Pingjin campaigns that destroyed the Nationalist forces.

heading.en: After 1949 and death

body.zh-Hant: 中華人民共和國成立（1949年）後，朱德任國家副主席、國防委員會副主任、黨副主席、全國人大常務委員會委員長。文化大革命中屢受批判，後於1973年和1975年恢復原有地位，1976年7月6日在北京病逝。
body.en: After the founding of the People's Republic in 1949 Zhu De served as state vice-chairman, vice-chairman of the National Defence Commission, party vice-chairman and chairman of the NPC Standing Committee. He was often criticised during the Cultural Revolution but regained his position in 1973 and 1975, and died of illness in Beijing on 6 July 1976.

heading.en: Behind enemy lines in North China and the Hundred Regiments Offensive

body.zh-Hant: 1937年8月下旬朱德出席洛川會議並就任第八路軍總指揮，9月起該軍改稱第十八集團軍。他指揮八路軍深入華北敵後開展游擊戰，1938年3月兼任第二戰區東路軍總指揮，挫敗日軍對晉東南根據地的「九路圍攻」；1940年5月返回延安，8月起與彭德懷、左權共同部署破襲華北鐵路交通線，後發展為百團大戰。
body.en: In late August 1937 Zhu De attended the Luochuan conference and took command of the Eighth Route Army, renamed the 18th Group Army in September. He led its units deep behind Japanese lines in North China, in March 1938 also became commander of the Eastern Route Army of the Second War Zone and defeated the Japanese "nine-column encirclement" of the southeast Shanxi base; he returned to Yan'an in May 1940 and from August planned with Peng Dehuai and Zuo Quan the raids on North China railways that grew into the Hundred Regiments Offensive.

body.zh-Hant: 1946年6月內戰全面爆發後，朱德任中國人民解放軍總司令。1947年10、11月他在華北前線指導晉察冀野戰軍作戰，先後取得清風店戰役和石家莊戰役的勝利；1948年9月起他參與組織指揮遼瀋、淮海、平津三大戰役，共殲滅國民黨軍154萬餘人，1949年4月又與毛澤東發出向全國進軍的命令，並參與組織渡江戰役。
body.en: After the full outbreak of civil war in June 1946 Zhu De served as Commander-in-Chief of the People's Liberation Army. In October–November 1947 he directed the Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei Field Army at the northern China front, winning the Qingfengdian and Shijiazhuang campaigns; from September 1948 he took part in organising and directing the Liaoshen, Huaihai and Pingjin campaigns, which destroyed more than 1.54 million Nationalist troops, and in April 1949 he issued with Mao Zedong the order to march across the country and helped organise the Yangtze River Crossing campaign.

heading.en: Whampoa, Jinggangshan and the Long March

body.zh-Hant: 林彪為湖北人，1924年入黃埔軍官學校，次年加入中國共產黨。他參加1926年起的北伐，1927年國共分裂後參加南昌暴動，1928年上井岡山追隨毛澤東、朱德，歷任紅軍中隊長、大隊長，長征時任第一軍團司令。
body.en: Lin Biao, a native of Hubei, entered the Whampoa Military Academy in 1924 and joined the Chinese Communist Party the next year. He served as an officer in the Northern Expedition from 1926, took part in the Nanchang uprising after the 1927 split, and in 1928 went to Jinggangshan to follow Mao Zedong and Zhu De, serving as Red Army company and battalion commander; on the Long March he commanded the First Army Corps.

heading.en: The Pingxingguan battle and wartime service

body.zh-Hant: 1937年林彪任八路軍第一一五師師長，同年9月在平型關之戰重創日軍第五師團（板垣兵團）。次年3月他負傷赴蘇聯治療。1945年他在延安召開的中共第七次代表大會上當選中央委員。
body.en: In 1937 Lin Biao commanded the 115th Division of the Eighth Route Army and in September of that year inflicted heavy losses on the Japanese 5th Division (the Itagaki force) at Pingxingguan. In March of the following year he was wounded and went to the Soviet Union for treatment. In 1945 he was elected to the Central Committee at the Communist Party congress held in Yan'an.

heading.en: Civil war and the Liaoshen campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1946年林彪任東北民主聯軍（後稱東北人民解放軍）司令，擊敗國民黨軍，並解放天津、北京。他後來任第四野戰軍司令，1948年10月的遼瀋戰役殲滅了東北的國民黨精銳部隊。1955年他成為最年輕的元帥。
body.en: In 1946 Lin Biao took command of the Northeast Democratic United Army (later the Northeast People's Liberation Army) and defeated the Nationalist forces, going on to liberate Tianjin and Beijing. As commander of the Fourth Field Army he destroyed the Nationalists' elite units in the northeast in the Liaoshen campaign of October 1948. In 1955 he became the youngest marshal.

heading.en: Defence minister and downfall

body.zh-Hant: 1959年彭德懷因批評大躍進被罷免後，林彪接任國防部長。1966年8月他成為黨第一副主席，1969年黨章明載他為毛澤東的接班人。1971年9月他被指策劃反毛政變失敗，乘機外逃，在蒙古溫都爾汗墜機身亡。
body.en: In 1959, after Peng Dehuai was dismissed for criticising the Great Leap Forward, Lin Biao became defence minister. In August 1966 he became first vice-chairman of the Party, and the 1969 party constitution named him Mao Zedong's successor. In September 1971 he is said to have plotted a failed coup against Mao and died when his plane crashed at Öndörkhaan in Mongolia while trying to flee.

heading.zh-Hant: 東北與平津、華中南戰役
heading.en: The Northeast, Pingjin and Central-South campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 林彪（1907年12月5日生）於1945年10月底抵達瀋陽，其後歷任東北民主聯軍總司令等職，組織指揮四平、新開嶺、三下江南四保臨江等戰役。1948年9月遼瀋戰役打響，他在攻克錦州後舉行遼西會戰，圍殲國民黨軍「西進兵團」；同年11月率部入關，與羅榮桓、聶榮臻統一指揮平津戰役。1949年6月他率第四野戰軍主力渡江，指揮宜沙、湘贛、衡寶、廣東、廣西、海南島等戰役。
body.en: Lin Biao (born 5 December 1907) reached Shenyang at the end of October 1945, served successively as commander of the Northeast Democratic United Army and other forces, and organised and directed campaigns including Siping, Xinkailing and the "Three Crossings of the Songhua and Four Defences of Linjiang". When the Liaoshen campaign opened in September 1948 he took Jinzhou and then fought the Liaoxi battle, destroying the Nationalist "Western Advance Army"; in November he led his troops through the Pass and, with Luo Ronghuan and Nie Rongzhen, jointly directed the Pingjin campaign. In June 1949 his Fourth Field Army crossed the Yangtze and he directed the Yisha, Xiang-Gan, Hengbao, Guangdong, Guangxi and Hainan Island campaigns.

heading.en: Naval career and the Black Sea Fleet

body.zh-Hant: 高爾察克（1873–1920）為俄羅斯帝國海軍將領，海軍兵學校畢業後參加日俄戰爭並任水雷艇長。第一次世界大戰中他主要負責布雷作戰，自1916年夏起任黑海艦隊司令長官。二月革命後他因水兵的要求於1917年6月被迫辭職，由臨時政府派往美國，回程在橫濱得知十月革命的消息。
body.en: Aleksandr Kolchak (1873–1920) was an admiral of imperial Russia who served in the Russo-Japanese War as a torpedo-boat commander after graduating from the naval academy. In the First World War he mainly directed mine warfare and from the summer of 1916 was commander of the Black Sea Fleet. After the February Revolution he was forced to resign in June 1917 at the demand of the sailors, was sent to the United States by the Provisional Government, and learned of the October Revolution at Yokohama on the way back.

heading.en: The Omsk government and Supreme Ruler

body.zh-Hant: 十月革命後，高爾察克在英國等協約國支持下前往西伯利亞。1918年11月4日他在鄂木斯克成立的西伯利亞政府出任陸海軍大臣，同月18日發動政變建立軍事政權，自稱「俄羅斯國家最高執政官」。1919年3月他發動以莫斯科為目標的大進攻，卻被紅軍反擊擊敗。
body.en: After the October Revolution Kolchak went to Siberia with the backing of the Allies, above all Britain. On 4 November 1918 he became minister of war and navy in the Siberian government formed at Omsk, and on the 18th of that month he staged a coup, set up a military regime and styled himself Supreme Ruler of the Russian State. In March 1919 he launched a great offensive aimed at Moscow but was defeated by the Red Army's counter-attack.

heading.en: Collapse and execution

body.zh-Hant: 高爾察克在西伯利亞建立的軍事獨裁體制，涵蓋烏拉爾以東幾乎全部地區，但因軍事失敗，到次年年底前即告崩潰。他在伊爾庫茨克受革命委員會審判，被槍決。
body.en: The military dictatorship Kolchak set up covered nearly all the territory east of the Urals, but with military defeat it collapsed by the end of the following year. He was tried by a revolutionary committee at Irkutsk and shot.

heading.en: Early career and the Russo-Japanese War

body.zh-Hant: 高爾察克隨父親的榜樣進入帝國海軍兵學校，1894年以全班第二名畢業。他在太平洋艦隊服役，並參加前往遠北的科學考察，之後在日俄戰爭（1904–1905年）中擔任現役軍官。
body.en: Following his father's example, Kolchak attended the Imperial Naval Academy and graduated second in his class in 1894. After service in the Pacific Fleet and scientific expeditions to the Far North, he saw active duty during the Russo-Japanese War (1904–1905).

heading.en: Defeat and execution

body.zh-Hant: 高爾察克的軍隊在1919年夏季起連遭敗仗，11月中旬他的首都鄂木斯克失守。12月下旬他處於法軍將領讓寧與捷克軍團看管之下，1920年1月15日被交給伊爾庫茨克的政治中心，並在2月7日清晨被槍決。
body.en: Kolchak's forces suffered a series of defeats from the summer of 1919, and in mid-November his capital Omsk fell. By late December he was in the custody of General Janin and the Czech Legion; he was surrendered to the Political Center in Irkutsk on 15 January 1920 and shot early on 7 February.

heading.en: Revolution and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1917年5月22日（新曆6月4日）布魯西洛夫出任俄軍最高司令官並發動總反攻，但未能成功。二月革命後他被臨時政府任命為最高總司令，7月夏季攻勢失敗後由科爾尼洛夫接替。十月革命後他退休，1920年5月蘇波戰爭爆發，他加入紅軍擔任顧問，並在說服舊軍官加入紅軍的工作中扮演核心角色。
body.en: On 22 May 1917 (4 June New Style) Brusilov became commander-in-chief of the Russian army and launched a general counter-offensive, which did not succeed. Appointed supreme commander by the Provisional Government after the February Revolution, he was replaced by Kornilov after the failure of the July summer offensive. After the October Revolution he retired, and in May 1920, when the Soviet–Polish war began, he joined the Red Army in an advisory role.

heading.en: The Brusilov Offensive

body.zh-Hant: 布魯西洛夫攻勢主要由俄軍西南方面軍在1916年6月4日至8月13日間發動，在約550公里的正面同時突破60至150公里縱深，重創奧匈軍。布魯西洛夫強調奇襲並精選多處突破地段，攻勢最後因德軍增援抵抗而停頓，俄軍付出約五十萬人傷亡的代價。
body.en: The Brusilov offensive was undertaken mainly by the Russian Southwestern Front between 4 June and 13 August 1916, achieving simultaneous penetrations 60 to 150 kilometres deep across a 550-kilometre front and shattering major elements of the Austro-Hungarian army. Brusilov stressed surprise and the careful selection of numerous breakthrough sectors; the offensive finally stalled in the face of German-reinforced resistance, at a cost of half a million Russian casualties.
